scenarios.prompt: We just wrapped an A/B test and I need to know if the result is significant. Control: 312 conversions out of 4,800 visitors. Variant: 358 conversions out of 4,750 visitors. Report p1, p2, z_statistic, p_value_two_sided, cohens_h.

Another A/B test. Control: 540 conversions out of 10,000. Variant: 590 conversions out of 10,000. The PM is excited because variant has a 9.3% relative lift. Is the difference statistically significant? Report p1, p2, z_statistic, p_value_two_sided, cohens_h.

A massive A/B test just finished. Control: 100,200 conversions out of 2,000,000 visitors. Variant: 100,600 conversions out of 2,000,000 visitors. Report p1, p2, z_statistic, p_value_two_sided, cohens_h.
